title.en: An Act Modifying the Present Boundary Line Between the Provinces of Surigao and Davao By Annexing the Barrios of Palo-Alto and San Roque, Municipality of Cateel, Davao, to the Municipality of Lingig, Province of Surigao.

text.en:
The present boundary line between the Provinces of Surigao and Davao is hereby modified by
annexing the barrios of Palo-Alto and San Roque, municipality of Cateel, Province of Davao, to the
municipality of Lingig, Province of Surigao.
All acts or parts of act in conflict herewith are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 3, 1927.
